testimonials.title: Testimonials
testimonials.footer: Feedback from people I've had the pleasure of working with.
testimonials.items.0.name: Joshua Calducchi
testimonials.items.0.body:
Hieu is a dependable engineer who consistently delivers clear value. He maintains a high level of performance, contributes meaningfully to product quality, and made a lasting impact on the team — even before I joined Poppy.
I truly appreciate everything Hieu has contributed, especially his support during my early days on the team. I'd gladly serve as a reference, and I look forward to the chance to work with him again on future projects.
testimonials.items.1.name: Katherine Patton
testimonials.items.1.body: Hieu is a reliable engineer who brings clarity and efficiency to his work. His positive attitude and collaborative spirit make him easy to work with across teams. He approaches challenges with a solution-first mindset, holds a high bar for execution, and helps raise overall productivity. His ability to balance quality with speed is especially valuable on critical projects, and his proactive support has had a real impact on both team efficiency and outcomes.
testimonials.items.2.name: Dat Giang
testimonials.items.2.role: CTO at HDWEBSOFT Technology Co., Ltd.
testimonials.items.2.body: Hieu shows a strong sense of ownership and professionalism in everything he does. Beyond his technical ability, his proactive communication and willingness to help others really stand out. He brings a calm, positive energy to the team even under pressure, and consistently delivers results aligned with business goals. His contributions have had a meaningful impact on both product stability and team culture. He also gets ahead of problems early and always supports his teammates toward better outcomes.
testimonials.items.3.name: Matthew Zhao
testimonials.items.3.body: Working with Hieu is always smooth. He responds quickly, pays attention to detail, and makes sure he fully understands the requirements before building. His positive attitude and proactive spirit help keep the whole team moving. He doesn't just meet expectations — he regularly suggests improvements that raise the user experience and the value of the product. He also communicates effectively with stakeholders and helps improve coordination across teams.
testimonials.items.4.name: Benjamin Papillon
testimonials.items.4.body:
Hieu was the first engineer I hired, and we started talking about working together just weeks after I founded the company in the summer of 2021. He built our first website and many of the critical systems that followed.
He has been an incredibly versatile colleague, partner, and friend. I can hardly imagine taking the company from pre-revenue to post-Series A without him. Together we grew the business nationwide, worked through countless challenges, and still delivered — all while keeping a strong team culture.
testimonials.items.5.name: Nico Martinez
testimonials.items.5.body: Hieu combines strong technical skills with a genuine team spirit. He is enthusiastic, open to feedback, and always looking to improve both his own craft and the systems he owns. His structured approach to problem-solving and attention to detail lead to solutions that are sustainable and easy to maintain. I truly value his contributions and look forward to collaborating on future projects — growing together and achieving great results across many different environments.
testimonials.items.6.name: Daniel Bailey
testimonials.items.6.body: Hieu, it has been a real pleasure getting to know you and working with you. You are not only a talented engineer and a steady leader, but also a wonderful person. Your focus and dedication are truly admirable. I value the time we spent working together and hope we stay in touch. Wishing you all the best on the exciting road ahead — keep achieving great things in everything you take on. I will always appreciate your positive influence and support.

about.summary.lead:
I've been working in software for more than five years. I enjoy solving problems (in general, but mostly with software), building products, and helping teams grow. I've worked across many different software systems and genuinely enjoy evolving them over time to meet changing needs. I've also spent a lot of time on scaling — both improving performance and building the processes and automation that keep changes safe as usage grows.
Outside of work, I'm passionate about bonsai and building wooden furniture for my home.

That may sound like a lot — but really, I'm just excited to meet new people and collaborate with new partners!

exp.title: Work Experience
exp.hdwebsoft.tech: React, Vue.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, NestJS, AWS (Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, SQS, API Gateway), PostgreSQL, MySQL, TypeORM, Salesforce (Apex, LWC, Platform Events), Stripe, Plaid, SendGrid, OpenAI, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Git
exp.hdwebsoft.note: Also contributed to several smaller internal projects using Python, Java, and more, within an Agile/Scrum team structure.
exp.hdwebsoft.projects.convoso.title: Convoso
exp.hdwebsoft.projects.convoso.subtitle: Salesforce CTI Managed Package — for Convoso
exp.hdwebsoft.projects.convoso.highlight: Designed, built, and maintain ConvosoCTIAdapter end-to-end — a Salesforce second-generation managed package (2GP) that integrates Convoso's cloud dialer with Salesforce CRM as a native CTI adapter, spanning ~400 Apex classes (289 production + 106 test) organized into 20+ feature modules (auth, leads, calls, campaigns, dispositions, voicemail, recordings, queues, dashboards, app settings, retry/recovery).

Applied a consistent Layer → Service → Controller Action architecture across the entire package, with centralized CRUD/FLS enforcement (AccessEnforcer/AccessPolicy) at every entry point so no feature bypasses object- or field-level security.

Designed the package's asynchronous processing backbone: 20+ queueable workers, 13 batch jobs, and scheduled jobs with custom job locking (ConvosoJobLock__c) to prevent duplicate execution, plus a Platform Event (ConvosoEvent__e) pub/sub layer and trigger framework for real-time telephony event sync.

Built and maintain all 69 Lightning Web Components, including a multi-tab softphone widget embedded in the Salesforce Utility Bar, orchestrated by a central screen state machine and Lightning Message Service for cross-component communication.
Own the OAuth 2.0 / Named Credential integration layer (ConvosoApi, ConvosoAuthTokenApi) and the automatic snake_case ↔ camelCase key translation between Apex and the Convoso REST API.

Set and enforced the package's technical bar across ~4,200 commits and a year of continuous development: 85%+ meaningful Apex test coverage, Salesforce Security Review, Checkmarx SAST, and PMD/ESLint code analysis — as the engineer accountable for the entire codebase, not a single feature slice.
exp.hdwebsoft.projects.poppy.title: Poppy Flowers
exp.hdwebsoft.projects.poppy.subtitle: Wedding Floral Marketplace
Owned end-to-end development of Poppy, a high-traffic marketplace connecting couples with local floral designers for wedding planning, built with React.js and Node.js, with the backend progressively migrated to NestJS, including AWS serverless components and PostgreSQL.

Architected and deployed RESTful APIs and asynchronous backend services on AWS serverless (Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, SQS, API Gateway); handled high-concurrency scenarios through backend caching strategies and SQS-based service decoupling for asynchronous background processing.
Improved system performance and response times by optimizing TypeORM/Prisma queries and PostgreSQL indexing as data volumes scaled.
Built and maintained a shared, reusable React component library used across products, improving UI consistency and reuse; simplified complex frontend state management with Zustand, Redux, and Immer.
Integrated third-party services — Stripe, Plaid, SendGrid, OpenAI — into core marketplace workflows (payments, notifications, and design-matching features), reducing manual processing overhead.
exp.hdwebsoft.projects.transit.title: 2D Transit
exp.hdwebsoft.projects.transit.subtitle: CBPO | FBA Logistics SaaS Platform
exp.hdwebsoft.projects.transit.highlight: Owned end-to-end development of 2D Transit, a high-throughput, multi-tenant SaaS platform for Amazon FBA shipment labeling and warehouse validation, serving seller workspaces from individual Amazon sellers to enterprise brand portfolios; built with Vue.js (Vue 2/3, Composition API), Node.js (Express/Hapi), and MongoDB Atlas, deployed on GCP.
Architected RESTful APIs for multi-tier workspace/user/role management (RBAC + custom permissions), supporting concurrent multi-warehouse operations with strict tenant-level data isolation.
Designed the SafetyNet automated validation engine to catch scan-to-print errors in real time, significantly reducing shipment check failures and sellers' exposure to Amazon manual-processing fees.

Optimized the backend for high-concurrency label printing across multiple simultaneous network printers (via PrintNode), tuning MongoDB indexing and query patterns to sustain performance through peak shopping events (e.g., Prime Day, Black Friday) when scan/print volume spikes severalfold.
Built and maintained a reusable Vue component library (Pinia/Vuex, Vue Router) across shipment and workspace modules, improving UI consistency and reducing duplicated logic in the SPA.

Integrated third-party services — Amazon SP-API, EasyPost, PrintNode, Stripe — into core logistics workflows (shipment sync, carrier labeling, network printing, subscription billing), reducing manual overhead and improving data accuracy with Seller Central.
exp.toyar.tech: React.js, React Native, Flutter, Vite, JavaScript, Spring Boot, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda), Jenkins, Bitbucket, Datadog, CI/CD, Git
exp.toyar.projects.fidobox.title: FidoBox
exp.toyar.projects.fidobox.subtitle: E-commerce Platform
exp.toyar.projects.fidobox.highlights.0: Owned end-to-end development of FidoBox, an e-commerce marketplace app that reached the Top 5 most-downloaded shopping apps in Vietnam within 5 months of launch, built with React (Vite) on web and React Native/Flutter on mobile, powered by Spring Boot REST APIs.
exp.toyar.projects.fidobox.highlights.1: Designed and implemented core commerce services — product discovery/search, product details with ratings/reviews, cart/checkout, order management, and a loyalty points/voucher system — while optimizing PostgreSQL performance through execution-plan analysis and targeted indexing as transaction volume grew.
exp.toyar.projects.fidobox.highlights.2: Built gamified retention features, including a promotional treasure-hunt game and voucher-hunting flows, along with in-app notification and chat systems connecting buyers with sellers and support.
exp.toyar.projects.fidobox.highlights.3: Implemented supplier/vendor and affiliate (CTV) onboarding workflows powering the multi-brand marketplace (partners including Xiaomi, Samsung, Nintendo, and Asus), plus cross-border ordering and product-authenticity verification logic.
exp.toyar.projects.fidobox.highlights.4: Restructured legacy cart/checkout modules to improve performance and reduce production defects as the platform scaled.
exp.toyar.projects.fidobox.highlights.5: Managed and optimized production infrastructure on AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda), set up CI/CD pipelines via Jenkins and Bitbucket, integrated secure payment gateways, and enforced RESTful API design with CRUD/data-access controls over the PostgreSQL data layer.
exp.toyar.projects.fidovn.title: FidoVN
exp.toyar.projects.fidovn.subtitle: AI-Driven Jobs & Real Estate Super-App
exp.toyar.projects.fidovn.highlights.0: Owned end-to-end development of FidoVN, a two-sided platform combining AI/big-data-driven job recruitment with real-estate search, reaching 120,000+ users, 10,000+ businesses, and 2,000+ brokers within 8 months of launch.
exp.toyar.projects.fidovn.highlights.1: Built the job-marketplace flows for candidates and employers (search, job-posting management, application tracking) along with an AI-assisted CV builder and a big-data-driven job recommendation feed.
exp.toyar.projects.fidovn.highlights.2: Implemented in-app interview scheduling and video calls between candidates and employers, and built a knowledge library hub (courses and podcasts) for career skill development.
exp.toyar.projects.fidovn.highlights.3: Implemented real-time equity, principal, interest, and monthly-payment calculators for an interactive property loan/mortgage estimator, and integrated a 360° VR viewer for remote property tours.
exp.toyar.projects.fidovn.highlights.4: Built map-based housing search with a verified home/rental badge system, in-app tenant calling/messaging, and rental management and tracking tools for owners and brokers.
exp.toyar.projects.fidovn.highlights.5: Implemented multilingual (i18n) support across web and mobile, and integrated third-party services such as SMS verification and mapping/geolocation into core account and search flows.
exp.toyar.projects.fidovn.highlights.6: Across both platforms, applied OOP principles and design patterns consistently on the Java/Spring Boot backend and JavaScript/TypeScript frontends, running on Linux (Ubuntu) production servers and Windows development environments; led architecture design sessions, conducted code reviews, and mentored junior developers within an Agile/Scrum workflow (sprint planning, daily standups, retrospectives), using Git and Jira for version control and task tracking.
exp.optoro.tech: Ruby on Rails, AngularJS, CoffeeScript, JavaScript, Git, HTML, CSS
exp.optoro.items.0: Developed and enhanced features on Optoro's core product using Ruby on Rails, AngularJS, CoffeeScript, and JavaScript; implemented new functionality, fixed bugs, and refactored legacy code to improve maintainability and performance.
exp.optoro.items.1: Participated in code reviews and coordinated with team members to keep code quality high before production deployment; shipped changes to production following established release processes.
exp.optoro.items.2: Built internal tools and scripts to improve development workflows and team efficiency; collaborated with product and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.
exp.optoro.items.3: Worked in a Git-based version-control workflow, contributing to a codebase shared across many contributors.
exp.mindx.items.0: Taught full-stack web development (React, Node.js, Next.js, React Native) and ran technical workshops across multiple branches.
exp.mindx.items.1: Mentored and managed 50+ instructors, contributing to curriculum design and raising overall training quality.
projects.title: All Projects
project.walkerip.description: Walker IP is an Australian intellectual-property law firm providing patent, trademark, and industrial-design registration services for startups and large enterprises. Specializing in engineering, technology, biotech, and medical-device innovation, the firm guides clients through complex IP processes with expert legal counsel to protect and commercialize their innovations effectively.
project.flightlocal.description: Flight Local is a B2B travel portal built specifically for travel agencies, enabling seamless booking of flights, hotels, holiday packages, and visas. The platform features booking queue management, real-time reporting, payment processing, and markup configuration tools, helping agencies streamline operations and serve their customers faster and more efficiently.
project.tapy.description: Tapy is a mobile marketing app designed for small businesses to grow sales through personalized promotions delivered directly to existing customers. Achieving engagement rates 10x higher than email and 7.2x higher than traditional social media, Tapy helps local businesses build loyalty, increase repeat purchases, and grow revenue with minimal marketing effort.
project.khora.description: Khora is a Spanish urban consultancy tackling city-development challenges through a creative process of discovering, testing, and scaling innovative solutions. On a mission to build smarter, more sustainable, better-connected cities, Khora partners with governments and organizations to design urban strategies that improve quality of life for communities.
project.granada.description: AI Lab Granada is Spain's leading AI innovation hub, offering a collaborative platform that connects medium and large enterprises with top AI talent, cutting-edge technology, and applied research. The lab helps organizations improve operational efficiency, accelerate digital transformation, and drive sustainable growth through custom artificial-intelligence solutions and innovation partnerships.
project.travel.description: The Tryotel mobile app is a B2C travel application that lets users search and book flights, hotels, and holiday packages right from their phones. Built with a clean material design and intuitive multi-layer navigation, the app is tailored to young, active travelers looking for a fast, seamless, and visually engaging travel-booking experience on the go.
project.tryotel.description: Tryotel is a Bangladesh-based B2C travel platform that makes it easy for users to book flights, holiday packages, visas, and hotels online. The platform integrates promotional campaigns, multiple payment methods, and cross-platform mobile apps, delivering a complete, convenient travel-planning experience for customers across Bangladesh and international destinations.
project.thought.description: A Higher Thought is an online inspiration platform offering motivational videos, memes, articles, and positive-lifestyle products to uplift and encourage its community. Users can freely explore, save, and share content across social channels, spreading positivity and meaningful messages that inspire personal growth and bring encouragement to people around the world.
project.poppy.description: Poppy is a wedding floral service platform that lets couples browse flower collections, build fully customized wedding-flower proposals, and receive transparent upfront pricing. The platform handles full-service floristry including professional design consultation, delivery, and on-site setup, making it simple and enjoyable to create a beautiful, stress-free wedding flower experience.
project.fidovn.description: Fido.vn is a Vietnamese online recruitment platform connecting job seekers with employers through smart job posting and CV search. Tailored to Gen Z professionals, it features an AI-powered CV builder that automatically generates polished, professional resumes, helping young candidates stand out and find the right career opportunities faster in a competitive job market.
project.multiangle.description: Multiangle AI is an advanced artificial-intelligence platform that equips businesses with sophisticated analytics, automation, and machine-learning capabilities. Designed to drive innovation and sustainable growth, the platform gives organizations intelligent tools and data-driven insights to streamline operations, uncover opportunities, and make smarter strategic decisions in an increasingly competitive digital landscape.
project.tattoo.description: The Trung Tattoo is a professional tattoo studio website showcasing custom tattoo services, detailed artwork collections, transparent pricing, and the complete tattooing process. Clients can explore the studio's portfolio, read genuine customer reviews, and conveniently book consultations online to discuss their ideas and receive a high-quality, personalized tattoo experience from skilled artists.
project.baby.description: BabyQuip is a baby-gear rental platform connecting traveling families with trusted local providers in thousands of locations. All equipment — including cribs, strollers, and car seats — is delivered to your accommodation, thoroughly cleaned, and safety-checked before every rental. The platform also offers party rentals and professional baby-gear cleaning services for added convenience.
project.signinapp.description: Sign In App is a smart workplace and visitor management platform that seamlessly combines visitor check-in, employee sign-in, space booking, and emergency response in one connected system. Trusted by 25,000+ sites worldwide and certified for ISO 27001, GDPR, and HIPAA compliance, it helps organizations of every size manage access, safety, and workplace experience with ease.
project.singlekey.description: SingleKey is a comprehensive rental risk-management platform built for Canadian landlords. It provides thorough tenant screening with credit and background checks, automated monthly rent collection, and guaranteed income protection covering up to $60,000 in unpaid rent, $10,000 in property damage, and $2,000 in eviction legal fees — giving landlords complete peace of mind.
project.swipedon.description: SwipedOn is a workplace and people management software trusted by 9,000+ workplaces globally. It tracks employee check-ins, supports hybrid work arrangements, and enables easy desk and meeting-room booking from any device. Now merging with Sign In App, SwipedOn is evolving into a next-generation unified platform for smarter, safer workplace management.
